title: OpenCode V2 binding launch values
description: Values passed individually as ELIOT_SWARM_CONFIG_<KEY>; they are copied from the exact immutable OpenCode route and are not synthesized by the supervisor.

OPENCODE_SERVICE_ID.description: Operator-stable OpenCode service namespace; independent of native PID and GM incarnation.

OPENCODE_CONNECTION_FILE.description: Absolute path to the existing operator-owned OpenCode connection record.

OPENCODE_EXPECTED_VERSION.description: Exact expected version reported by the attached server.

OPENCODE_DIRECTORY.description: Absolute workspace path; mapped from the selected route's directory value.

OPENCODE_PROVIDER_ID.description: Case-sensitive OpenCode providerID from the selected Manager route; no alias or default.
